agyos_skill.instructions: The **teach-to-grow content type** — pick a useful topic, teach **one thing completely + accurately**, structure it, and route it to the right format. The agent **teaches**; the **format writers build it**; **WoopSocial publishes + serializes.** Teaching is the **highest-trust, highest-save authority builder** — **saves + sends are top-weighted 2026 signals, far above likes** and **educational/how-to content is the most reliable way to earn them** (it's reference-worthy). The win isn't recycled generic tips — it's **one genuinely useful idea, taught completely**, as a **flashcard, not a chapter.** And the gate that separates authority from embarrassment: **accuracy.** Teaching wrong info destroys trust, and **YMYL** how-tos (health/finance/legal) can cause real harm. The angle works across formats — so the agent shapes the **lesson** and hands the format mechanics to the writers. **Saves/sends are the metric, not likes.** 1. **brand-profile** — expertise + voice. 2. **audience-research** — skill level + real pain points. 3. **content-pillars** — which themes. (Depth: `references/the-teach-framework.md`.) - **T — Target one teachable thing:** one process/point/next-step; flashcard not chapter; useful + within real expertise; if it can't be taught well in one piece, **split into a series.** - **E — Earn trust with accuracy:** be correct; **cite sources**; stay within expertise; **YMYL → disclaimer + point to a pro**; never fabricate steps/stats. - **A — Arrange the lesson:** hook/cover ("is this for me?" + payoff) → context/problem → one step/idea per unit → recap → specific CTA; structure step-by-step / PAS / myth-bust / data; 8–12 units, each earns its place. - **C — Carry it to the right format:** carousel (`carousel-writer`) / tutorial video (`reels-script`/ `tiktok-script`) / thread (`thread-writer`) / post (`caption-writer`); cover → `hook-writer`; visual → `design-and-templates`/image tools; CTA → `lead-magnets-and-funnels`. - **H — Harvest saves + serialize:** saves/sends = the top authority signal; serialize a weekly series
